name: Mintleaf Beebalm
desc: Mintleaf Beebalm (Monarda fistulosa): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Monarda fistulosa, the wild bergamot or bee balm, is a wildflower in the mint family Lamiaceae, widespread and abundant as a native plant in much of North America.
